newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Southern Cement lifts net, in bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Southern Cement lifts net, in bonus issue.

text.p: Saudi Arabia's Southern Cement lifted 1996 net profit to 237.2 million riyals from 233.5 million in 1995 and announced a dividend of 30 riyals per share, the official Saudi Press Agency said on Monday.
Southern Cement's chairman Khalid bin Turki al-Turki was quoted as saying the company's output rose slightly to 2.324 million tonnes from 2.299 million the previous year.
He said sales climbed to 2.66 million tonnes from 2.61 million in 1995, the agency said.

Turki said the company had offered shareholders a bonus share for every two held, increasing the number of shares to 10.5 million from seven million. He said the company had thus raised its capital to 1.05 billion riyals from a 700 million.
